summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Health and Human Services to revise regulations by January 1, 2026, to allow virtual diabetes prevention program suppliers to participate in the Medicare Diabetes Prevention Program Expanded Model, permit claims for online services regardless of the beneficiary's location, and remove limits on how many times an individual can enroll in the program.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the Medicare Diabetes Prevention Program to include virtual services and removes limits on enrollment, making healthcare services more accessible for diabetes prevention. This leans towards more public healthcare by expanding a government program.

The bill's sole purpose is to expand the Medicare Diabetes Prevention Program by mandating inclusion of virtual suppliers, removing enrollment caps, and easing cross-state claims rules. This constitutes direct government action to broaden access and coverage within a federal health program.
